display.purpose: Library arrival statements and primary editorial hierarchy.

body.purpose: Descriptions, instructions, and public explanatory copy.

shadows.name: search-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the public search field from the mineral page field.

shadows.name: admin-sheet
shadows.purpose: Separate the operational panel from the ink-blue Admin background.

motion.name: route-shift
motion.purpose: Small directional movement for document-row arrows and state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A decisive square action for publishing or sign-in.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { background:#f26b21; color:#071e4a; padding:12px 16px; border:0; border-radius:0; font:900 14px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background:#ff873f; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #071e4a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Library Search
components.description: The large public search entry point.
components.html: <input class="ds-search-field" aria-label="Search the library" placeholder="Search the collection">
components.css: .ds-search-field { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#fff; color:#071e4a; border:2px solid #071e4a; border-radius:0; padding:16px 20px; font:600 16px/1.25 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { color:#526889; } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #071e4a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Route Control
components.description: A category route that exposes selection through a colored marker and clear pressed state.
components.css: .ds-route { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; background:transparent; color:#071e4a; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(7,30,74,.2); border-radius:0; padding:12px 4px; font:600 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-route:hover { background:#d9f4eb; } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #071e4a; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-route-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:9999px; background:#f26b21; } .ds-route span:last-child { margin-left:auto; color:#526889; }

components.name: Document Record
components.description: A whole-record library link organized by a single horizontal rule.
components.css: .ds-record { display:grid; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(7,30,74,.2); padding:20px 0; color:#071e4a; font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-record p { margin:0; color:#087465; font-size:12px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.13em; } .ds-record h3 { margin:0; font-size:24px; line-height:1.15; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-record span { color:#526889; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: A square metadata marker, never a raised pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; border:1px solid rgba(7,30,74,.25); border-radius:0; padding:4px 8px; color:#27416c; font:600 12px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Alexandria is a useful public institution expressed as an interface: confident, orderly, and deliberately non-antiquarian. Ink-blue rules turn navigation and grouping into visible wayfinding; a warm mineral field makes the material approachable instead of sterile.
keyCharacteristics: Search-first public discovery with a visible route structure.
Strong, square editorial rules instead of soft consumer-app cards.
Sparse route signals rather than decorative color.
System typography, high contrast, and complete tap targets.

rules.name: Route-Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange, mint, green, and violet identify a route, state, or action. Do not use them as broad decorative fills.

rules.name: One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a display serif or decorative font. Alexandria’s authority comes from hierarchy, rules, and spacing.

rules.name: Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to every document row or card. Lift only a surface that needs spatial priority.

dos: Do use Ink Blue rules and mineral space to establish hierarchy before adding a new container.
Do make search, filters, buttons, and complete document rows keyboard reachable with visible focus.
Do use route color sparingly to make category paths and primary actions faster to scan.
donts: Don't use rounded, shadowed dashboard cards for ordinary library records.
Don't use parchment textures, faux bookshelves, classical columns, or antique-library imagery.
Don't cache API or authenticated Admin responses in the PWA shell.
